title: should open the query-picker confirm dialog from a multi-query panel and land on the pre-filled alert form
verifies: a panel with two visible SQL queries opens the confirm dialog in pickQueryOnly mode (query picker + picked query, threshold/window/preview suppressed) and Continue routes to the pre-filled alert form

title: should update the picked-query text when a different query is selected in the dialog
verifies: selecting the other query re-runs the panel adapter and the picked-query text follows the selection

title: should close the confirm dialog on Cancel and stay on the dashboard
verifies: Cancel closes the confirm dialog with no route change to the alert form

title: should disable the Create Alert menu item with a reason when the panel has no visible query
verifies: a panel with all queries hidden renders the Create Alert item disabled with the no-queries reason

title: should block Continue in the confirm dialog when the prefill carries an unresolved-query warning — deferred: unresolved-variable panel setup unproven in CI (fromPanel.ts:293-295)
verifies: a blocking unresolved-query warning disables Continue in the confirm dialog (deferred: setup not deterministic in CI)
